notes: Targeted searches for Ouled Djellal (wilaya created 2019, formerly part of Biskra) with data center/datacenter/server farm, French centre de donnees, cloud, and hyperscale terms found no public facility or project in the wilaya. Results were geography/tourism/earthquake pages and generic data-center databases. Algeria-wide sources list the known market as concentrated in Algiers/Cheraga, Constantine and Oran.

Targeted searches for Beni Abbes/Beni Abbes (wilaya created 2019, formerly part of Bechar) with data center/datacenter/server farm, French centre de donnees, hebergement, and cloud terms found no public facility or project in the wilaya. Hits were tourism/Wikipedia/oasis references and generic data-center explainers; confirmed Algeria data-center activity is outside Beni Abbes.

Targeted searches for In Salah (wilaya created 2019, formerly part of Tamanrasset) with data center/datacenter/centre de donnees terms found no public facility or project in the wilaya; the only data-center hit was the Ministry of Finance data center in Algiers (unrelated). In Salah's main IT-adjacent infrastructure is tied to the In Salah Gas industrial operations (BP/Sonatrach JV), for which no public datacenter project was found.

Targeted searches for In Guezzam/Ain Guezzam (wilaya created 2019 on the Niger border, formerly part of Tamanrasset) with data center, datacenter, centre de donnees, and informatique terms found no public facility or project. Results were Wikipedia/geography/airport pages and generic data-center databases; no local digital infrastructure announcements were found.

Hits were generic hosting providers, proxy services, and Algeria-wide data-center news about Constantine/Algiers/Oran.
